dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What can you tell us about the Scions of the Canopy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, kind of like us, then!

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'm not so sure. You don't strike me as the type to enjoy danger.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: The Scions of the Canopy are a bunch of thrill-seekers. They love extreme sports like rock climbing, rappelling, volcano parkour...

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: Or even bungee jumping without a rope while a Yumkasaur stands at the edge and uses its tongue to catch them. Sound like something you'd be interested in?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay... that does sound different from our usual "adventures."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's not doing any of that! She can just cheer you on from the sidelines!
